searchText: gm are there daily merge tests happening?, i think i heard someone talk about this, can i participate to carry out my tests? They are fully automated, not possible to join: https://hivetests2.ethdevops.io/ https://github.com/parithosh/nightly-kurtosis-test/actions :/ Q: sorry for the noobness, before the relays come online, which component in the validator is going to be constructing the blocks? reg execution client, like geth if ur running geth? Yes, geth will construct the blocks (even after the relays come online, mev-boost is opt-in, not required for block building) Did the `engine` suite change into smaller suites? We now have `engine-sync`, `engine-auth`, `engine-transition`, `engine-api`? Or did this change into `engine-api`? Yes it changed a bit, most tests ended up in `engine-api`, `auth` is jwt related tests, `transition` is merge transition related, `sync` is post-merge sync related tests. The general `engine` api tests ended up in `engine-api` OK great, thanks 😄 https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs Given that more hashrate is coming onboard speeding up the merge to the 13th (and likely the 11th or 12th by the time its done) will TTD be adjusted or are we rolling with it? I assume a Sunday (11th) would be bad while the rest are doable. I think at this point as long as it falls after bellatrix activation and before the end of the month if the hashrate drops, no change to the ttd will happen.. I could see that if its a weekday but a weekend is going to be difficult as most devs including core devs work weekdays. Not to mention the ones who go to church on Sunday. lmfao wait, you guys take saturday/sunday off? Paris is fine as long as it occurs before Bellatrix. Don't see a reason to change TTD blocks are only mined from 9 to 5 , Monday - Friday. Why is more hash rate coming aboard? A10 fixes? I don’t think inno actually did anything Most developers work for money 😄 most Ethereum open source development occurs due to developers working in companies. Not to mention the exchanges dapp companies and others. People only have guesses. If I were ETH foundation, I would pay/fund extra hash rate for 15 days to fend off suddenly drop of hash rate The opposite is occuring....so are you proposing they pay for miners to mine other coins lol. Easier to just adjust TTD slightly so it happens on Monday/Tuesday. https://bordel.wtf/ seems to stick with Sep 15 https://wenmerge.com/ has it down to the 13th and its going to be the 12th soon. It hasn't been such a big divergence either way, it'd be fair to say we're still well on target... Only issue is that hashrate is rapidly increasing and in a week it'll be too late to get everyone to adjust TTD. So I'm bringing this up now even though I'm pretty sure it'll be shot down. just for context I'm not trying to shoot you down... I think that it'd be a risk to alter TTD now, so we'd want a really good reason, and I'm not sure there's enough CPU in the world to push it before sept 6, so at this point I think we'd let it just be earlier than the 15th if that happens.. Yeah I don't think its a very strong argument. We're probably looking at Monday at the worst. I do agree with you in that if we did need to alter it, yesterday was a good day to do it But at least at the moment I'm not seeing anything that would compell me to suggest it's needed oh that's pretty Hashrate is weirdly rapidly increasing over the past few days....I don't know where it's coming from i think bordel is probably the main source i'm looking at to be honest, it seems pretty fair wenmerge has estimating 1-2 days sooner for days now than bordel 1-2 days is fine heh its kinda like childbirth imo, 1-2 days either way is expected even a week and we're still golden and bordel's target has only moved up maybe a few hours in that time And Wenmerge bases its prediction on 937GH/s When the network is now at 1phs one thing i do like about bordel is the red line much more reasonable representation of whats going on wenmerge does this just statically, or is that a linear extrapolation? Bordel predicts merge between the 11th-12th at 1phs where is 1phs from? > Current daily hashrate: 886.2 TH/s > > To achieve TTD 58750000000000000000000 at Thu Sep 15 12:00 2022 UTC, around 862.0 TH/s in the network is needed as of now. 11th-12th would still be totally fine Well we aren't statically run at 1PH Etherscan has the network at 949ths, MPS at 953ths If so then no worries. I thought a Sunday was undesirable. yeh undesirable, but its huge risk to change ttd and need everyone to apply it at late notice, i think we'd just live with it at this point Mind you, that's just my opinion ultimately 🙂 https://goerli.securerpc.com/ That branding >_< Q: if I send a 31m gas limit txn, will it live forever in the mempool? At what stage will it be cleaned up 🤔 I hear of some miners that will stop mining pre merge. Because they need to manualy change from eth to etc, and prefer to do in workhours/ or even in a prefered days. So i think two days before merge hashrate will be lower, so i dont think sunday Is probable don't believe the rumors etc pays 50% as much as eth and its just getting lower lol. I'd say 50% chance Monday, 20% chance Sunday.
